info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Contact Routing API
info.description: The Contact Routing API facilitates the efficient handling of customer inquiries across multiple banking channels. This endpoint allows users to retrieve the optimal routing information for customer contacts based on the specified parameters. Typical consumers include bank customer service representatives and automated systems that manage customer interactions. Use cases for this API include directing calls, messages, or other inquiries to the most suitable channel or representative, thereby enhancing customer experience and operational efficiency.
